description: Fork of exp090 with wider unembedder MLP: unembedder_mlp_mult=6 (hidden=576) vs exp090's 4 (hidden=384). All other settings unchanged: per-chunk partition_sets for residual_lut (within-chunk pairs only, no chunk weights), residual_tph_per_layer_factor=256, anchor inheritance from layer (i-1), inverse concat residual order, per-block LayerNorm, single optimizer (adam_lr=0.0003 wd=0.1).
